messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for `node-prod-gpu-09` — metric: node.kubelet.status.unready (score 8). Alert: kernel panic detected via serial-console. https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

PD-Bot: INC12345 created and auto-escalated to primary on-call (Alice). PagerDuty notes: auto-ack disabled; waiting for human ack.

Alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Any idea of customer impact?

Ben SRE: I see the host dropped at 2026-03-15T00:12:09Z. Monitoring shows multiple XID/PCIe errors before kernel oops. K8s shows node `NotReady` and pods evicted from GPU namespace.

Noah Support: Got a support ping at ~00:13 UTC — one customer reported inference calls failing with 502s. Looks limited to a few tenants using dedicated GPU pool.

Carla Infra: Attaching to serial console now. If it's a kernel oops + NVMe, we'll likely need a power-cycle and then hardware diag. Can someone cordon the node?

Alice (oncall): Cordon + drain started: ```sh
kubectl cordon node-prod-gpu-09
kubectl drain node-prod-gpu-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force\```

Ben SRE: Serial console excerpt (timestamped):
```
[    10.123456] nvme nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborting
[    10.456789] nvidia: GPU at PCI:0000:5e:00: Kernel panic - not syncing: Xid 66
[    10.456800] CPU: 1 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/1 Not tainted 5.15.0-xx
[    11.000001] ---[ end trace 0x0000000000000000 ]---
```

IncidentBot: Automated mitigation: redirecting new scheduling away from `gpu-pool-3` for 15m while node is marked drained. Fallback routing enabled for inference-service.

PD-Bot: PagerDuty note: escalation to infra lead in 10m if unresolved. (Already acked by Alice)

Carla Infra: Issuing IPMI power-cycle now (iLO request ID PC-789). Will monitor serial for POST messages.

Ben SRE: After power-cycle we got kernel messages then a stall — seems nvme module failing to mount. dmesg shows SMART ATA errors. Suspect nvme hardware fault.

Noah Support: Customer on the original ticket reports traffic returning to normal for most calls; a small % still hitting 502s but they downgraded severity. Let me know if we need to notify a broader incident.

Alice (oncall): Thanks. Currently: node drained, no active schedulable pods; fallback pool handled most traffic. Customer impact: brief 45–90s spike in 5xxs for 3 tenants, some requests retried successfully. We'll continue to monitor.

Carla Infra: Opening RMA/drive replacement ticket: RMA-3456. We'll schedule on-site swap and reimage as needed. Marking node `tainted=hardware-fault:NoSchedule` to avoid accidental scheduling.

Ben SRE: Adding note to logs and creating post-incident eval to run inference prompts against fallback models to check output parity.

Alice (oncall): Handing off to Ben SRE at 04:00 UTC for overnight monitoring and follow-up. I'm closing the PagerDuty incident as "mitigated, hardware RMA scheduled".

PD-Bot: INC12345 status -> Acknowledged -> Mitigated by Alice (oncall). Follow-up: RMA-3456.

IncidentBot: Reminder: file a short postmortem with SLO impact (token-latency and 5xx counts) and include the serial log snippet above.

Carla Infra: Will attach SMART logs and IPMI power cycle logs to the RMA ticket.

Ben SRE: Will take ownership of the follow-up and notify customers if we see regressions overnight.

Alice (oncall): Thanks team. React with :thumbsup: if handoff/notes clear.
